query:
SELECT s.id as student_id, s.name, s.enrollment, ss.id as session_student_id, ss.sessionId, ss.absent, ses.status, ses.problemNumber, ses.sessionNumber
FROM students s 
LEFT JOIN session_students ss ON s.id = ss.studentId
LEFT JOIN sessions ses ON ss.sessionId = ses.id
WHERE s.enrollment = '23211323';
